findings.location: 세 묶음 시범 EN ‘I was sorting photos and missed the call’; modern script turn1 ‘I missed your call while sorting the notices’; turn2 ‘Two sheets got wet.’
findings.problem: The translations weaken the target contrast: -느라고 explicitly gives the reason one could not answer, whereas ‘and/while’ can state only co-occurrence. The listening comprehension explicitly asks for distinct causes. The bare ‘got wet’ also omits the unwanted-outcome colouring of 젖고 말았어요.
findings.proposal: Model: ‘I couldn’t answer the call because I was busy sorting photos.’ Modern turn1: ‘I couldn’t answer your call because I was busy sorting the notices. What happened?’ Modern turn2: ‘My bottle leaked inside the bag. Unfortunately, two sheets ended up getting wet.’

findings.location: 새 확인 자료 KO ‘창가 선반’; EN ‘While cleaning a windowsill’; DE ‘Beim Putzen der Fensterbank’
findings.problem: A shelf by the window has been changed to the windowsill. The Korean specifies a shelf, and the account of the cup spill should preserve that object/location.
findings.proposal: EN first sentence: ‘While cleaning a shelf by the window, Hyuna directly saw a cup tip over and the spilled water reach the notebook cover.’ Align German ‘Fensterbank’ with ‘Regal am Fenster’; leave the Korean unchanged.
